title: ACEF Harness Attestation
description: Payload schema for harness_attestation records. The durable proof that a state transition (in one of the seven state classes step/finding/coverage_cell/regression/delivery/badge/attestation) was earned by bound evidence and a verifier signed off on the transition. Implements the Prove-It Doctrine per brief freddy-on-acef-requirements-v0.1.md §3.6 / §10.6. verifier.verifier_class MUST NOT be 'persona' or 'llm' — those classes lack the determinism required to attest state transitions and are excluded from the enum.

state_class.description: Hard-coded taxonomy of seven state classes per brief §24.5 / design decision D3. Values outside this enum emit ACEF-076 at validation time.

state_transition.description: The state transition this attestation witnesses.

bound_evidence_refs.description: Array of URNs of the records that justified the transition. Empty array emits ACEF-070 at validation. The SDK-level builder Package.attest() also rejects empty arrays before serialization (VAL-SDK-005).

verifier.description: Identity and class of the verifier that signed off on this state transition. The verifier_class enum deliberately EXCLUDES 'persona' and 'llm' per brief §3.6 / VAL-LOAD-001/002 — those classes lack the determinism required to attest state transitions and bundles with those values are rejected at load time.

fake_green_test_ref.description: URN of the fake-green test that proves this state class cannot be reached without the bound evidence. Per brief §24.5. Missing field emits ACEF-076.

attestation_signature.description: JWS detached signature over the attestation body. Algorithm MUST be RS256 or ES256; other algorithms emit ACEF-013. The signed_fields scope is normative per VAL-SIGNATURE-001.

signed_fields.description: Ordered list of fields covered by the signature. Per VAL-SIGNATURE-001, MUST equal exactly: ['attestation_id','state_class','state_transition','bound_evidence_refs','verifier','claim','fake_green_test_ref','signed_at','signer_kid'].

signer_kid.description: Key identifier from the bundle's JWKS.
